monitoring.codex_inspection_settings_auto_action_mo: Handle by probe result: delete accounts on HTTP 401/403 (invalid authentication); disable accounts when the final status is still non-200 after retries or quota exceeds the threshold; re-enable after a healthy check below the threshold.
Same handling as Strategy 4 (including delete on invalid authentication), but inspect only accounts that are already disabled.
Same handling as Strategy 4 (including delete on invalid authentication), but inspect only accounts that are currently enabled.

Strategy 4 deletes accounts when authentication is invalid (for example HTTP 401/403), auto-disables accounts that still return non-200 after retries or exceed the quota threshold, and auto-enables disabled accounts only after they recover below the threshold.
Strategy 5 uses the same handling as Strategy 4, but inspects only currently disabled accounts; invalid authentication is deleted, and recovered accounts below the threshold are re-enabled.
Strategy 6 uses the same handling as Strategy 4, but inspects only currently enabled accounts; invalid authentication is deleted, while other unhealthy accounts are disabled.
